Georgia Multi Trade Home Contractor

You're looking for a reliable Georgia multi-trade home contractor to handle your residential project, and Build Heritage is here to help. On this site, you can get a free, written, and itemized quote for your project, and learn more about the services offered by a licensed and insured contractor in Georgia.

How it Works for Your Project

Build Heritage serves metro Atlanta and Georgia, covering areas such as Atlanta, Marietta, and Alpharetta. The company offers 8 trades, including painting, drywall, flooring, and roofing. You can contact them through the quote form or by emailing info@buildheritage.org. They will respond within one business day with a quote that outlines the costs and scope of your project.

What You Get and What it Costs

The cost of services varies, but you can expect to pay between $9,000-$20,000 for a full roof replacement or $3,000-$8,000 for a whole-home interior repaint. It's also recommended to hold back 10-15% of the quote for potential hidden issues. You can find more detailed information in the 2026 cost guide, which was updated in August 2026.

Build Heritage offers 8 trades, including packing & moving, painting, drywall, flooring, and roofing.
